blockingIssues.problem: The description says to “Explain the four rendering and two ingestion observations,” which implies providing an explanation (a causal account) for those observations. The source explicitly states it only “locates visible warnings, not their internal cause,” so it does not support promising explanations of cause.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: "Parser warnings first appeared in rendering in four runs and in ingestion in two. This locates visible warnings, not their internal cause."
blockingIssues.constraint: The idea must not claim to explain causes of the observations. It can report counts/locations and must preserve that diagnosing internal causes requires further inspection.

blockingIssues.problem: The title, “Use the selected failure to locate the next intervention,” can be read to assert that the selected failure by itself locates the appropriate intervention. The source requires inspection of the failure’s actual preceding input and the earliest supported boundary before choosing an intervention, so the title overstates the immediacy of using the failure alone to locate the intervention.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: "For the next selected failure, the review requires inspection of its actual preceding input and the earliest supported boundary before choosing an intervention."
blockingIssues.constraint: The central claim must preserve that inspection of the failure’s preceding input and determination of the earliest supported boundary are required prior steps before selecting an intervention; the title must not imply the failure alone determines the intervention.
